# أَتَكَاسَلَ (ʔatakāsala) /ʔa.ta.kaː.sa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَاسَلَ (takāsala)
# أَتَكَاسَلْ (ʔatakāsal) /ʔa.ta.kaː.sal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَاسَلَ (takāsala)
